digest.component_or_area: integration test harness for binding lifecycle / reconciliation idempotency
propositions: BindingLifecycle.clear_absent and its absence-tracking siblings lack integration-tier mutation oracles; their no-churn contracts are pinned only at unit tier
out-of-window-but-alive keys are structurally unreachable in the idempotency fixture because all seeded keys are in-window, blocking the real path through clear_absent
the bound-but-absent direct GET in run_differs uses a REAL backend whose transport 404s for synthetic keys, preventing the harness fake from intercepting it

extend test_reconcile_idempotency.py harness with out_of_window/deleted key sets, fake 404 responses, and pre-registered reconcile_run_differs so wire_backend monkeypatch can inject JiraBackend(fake_client)

two new tests must verify clear_absent reaches out-of-window-alive keys with zero mutations and no updated_at stamp change, and verify the 404-to-alive roundtrip through note_absent and clear_absent's counter-reset branch

seeding unconditional updated_at stamp in clear_absent must flip test 1 RED via the timestamp oracle; dropping clear_absent reach or its counter-reset must flip tests 1 and 2 RED via spy and counter assertions
